project_scope_description.value: A/E investigation of domestic hot water recirculation system in Building 23H at VAMC Perry Point; identification of deficiencies; design documents (30%/60%/100% bid documents) to correct deficiencies within budget; 3D scan to BIM; asbestos survey and abatement design as required.
project_scope_description.quote: The intent of this project is to identify the reason for inefficient hot water circulation in Building 23H at the Perry Point Veterans Affairs Medical Center (PP VAMC). Once the problem(s) are identified, the A/E shall provide a solution utilizing the relevant documents on the VA Technical Information Library. The outcome of the the A/E efforts shall culminate with 30%, 60%, and 100% bid documents delivered to the VA.
